headline: Approved $645,000 for German Gerena School land takings and sales of Walnut, Greene, Brigham and King street lots; denied $100,000 outside legal counsel order.
summary: The council approved 23 grants and donations, from $500 to $1,308,213.15. It also approved $158,596.40 for DPW rideshare funding and moved NS Sumner Avenue to the Conservation Commission. Councilor Govan withdrew a motion to pause the food truck ordinance for 120 days.
decisions: Approved confirmation of Madeline Landrau to the Water & Sewer Commission, 9-0.
Approved the May revenue versus expenditure report, 10-0.
Approved Eversource Gas petition for King Street, 9-0.
Approved Eversource Gas petition for Margaret Street, 9-0.
Approved 15 grants and donations under the threshold, items 5–19, 8-0.
Approved Tobacco Control Grant of $121,682.00, 9-0.
Approved FY27 MassCall Grant of $125,000.00, 9-0.
Approved Mass in Motion grant of $139,805.00, 9-0.
Approved FY27 SLF Personnel and Operating Expenses Grant of $145,000.00, 9-0.
Approved FY27 SLF Trusts & Endowments Grant of $180,000.00, 9-0.
Approved Public Health Excellence for Capacity Building Engagement grant of $400,000.00, 9-0.
Approved FY27 Council on Aging Grant of $488,976.00, 9-0.
Approved FY27 GEU Grant of $1,308,213.15, 9-0.
Approved $158,596.40 for DPW rideshare funding, 9-0.
Approved transfer of NS Sumner Avenue (11280-0258) to the Conservation Commission, 10-0.
Approved sale of NS Walnut Street (11952-0169) to Springfield City of Homes Development, LLC for $170.62, 10-0.
Approved sale of SS Greene Street and Rear Greene Street (06032-0025, 06032-0027) to Springfield City of Homes Development, LLC for $341.30, 10-0.
Approved sale of NS Brigham Street (01870-0007) and NS Brigham Street (01870-0008) to Naylor Nation Real Estate, LLC for $5,000, 10-0.
Approved sale of NS King Street (07295-0028) to Springfield City of Homes Development, LLC for $6,737.80, 10-0.
Approved sale of NS Brigham Street (01870-0002), NS Brigham Street (01870-0003) and SS Walnut Street (11952-0065) to Naylor Nation Real Estate, LLC for $15,000, 10-0.
Approved $645,000 appropriation for taking for German Gerena School projects, 10-0.
Approved amendment to the order of taking for the New German Gerena School that corrected the current ownership, 10-0.
Order to retain independent outside legal counsel for the proposed $100,000 Capstone appropriation failed.
Councilor Govan withdrew her motion to pause the amended food truck ordinance for 120 days.
Approved resolution urging Commonwealth emergency funding for Department of Transitional Assistance, 9-0.
Approved election warrant with polling locations for the September 1st primary, 10-0.
